paragraphs.source_en: The planetary landing sites aren’t so great either. There are a few tantalizing moons spinning around Jupiter and Saturn—worlds like Enceladus and Europa that likely have warm subsurface water. If your goal is to find alien life in the solar system, these are great candidates. If your goal is to be that alien life, you’re better off closer to home. Using current methods, doing the trip safely is going to take you years, possibly decades depending on where you’re going. Until we have some very futuristic propulsion technology, these places will remain the magisterium of robotic space probes.
